name: siegeguess
description: SiegeGuess - Rainbow Six Siege Major 与 Six Invitational 选手竞猜游戏

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:pow && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter client test
scripts.test:local: pnpm --filter server test:local && pnpm --filter client test:local
